# PTM Electric, Inc.

> Licensed electrical contractor based in Loxahatchee, Florida, since 2009. Residential, commercial and light-industrial electrical work, plus standby generators through its Stormpower Generators division.

## Business facts
- Name: PTM Electric, Inc. (Small Business Enterprise)
- DBA: Stormpower Generators (standby generators) - https://stormpowergenerators.com
- Office: 16971 W. Hialeah Drive, Loxahatchee, FL 33470
- In business since: 2009
- Licenses: FL EC13004084, NC U.38360, SC SC-CLM.119110
- Insured
- Phone: 561-329-6974
- Email: paul@ptmelectric.com
- Bid requests: bids@ptmelectric.com
- Hours: Monday-Friday, 8 AM-5 PM

## Service area
- Electrical work: Palm Beach, Broward, Miami-Dade, Martin and St. Lucie counties
- Standby generators (Stormpower): Palm Beach, Broward, Martin and St. Lucie counties

## Residential services
- Custom builds
- Barns and stables
- Troubleshooting and repair
- Rewiring
- Generators (standby generator installation, maintenance and repair through Stormpower Generators)
- Panel and service upgrades
- FPL overhead to underground conversions (coordinated with FPL)
- EV chargers
- Surge protection
- Pool electrical
- PTM pulls permits and handles inspections on home jobs

## Commercial and light-industrial sectors
- Medical facilities
- Restaurants
- Shopping centers
- Laundry facilities
- Financial
- Retail
- Manufacturing
- Recycling facilities
- Port / shipping
- Educational

## Generator services (Stormpower Generators)
- Installation and start-up
- Maintenance plans (annual minor and major service, priority storm response for plan customers): https://stormpowergenerators.com/maintenance.html
- Service and repairs (diagnostics, no-start issues, transfer switches)
- Brands: Generac, Kohler, Briggs & Stratton
